About

Design that has to earn its place in the business.

I'm Brent — a senior product designer with twenty-plus years of experience across FinTech, e-commerce, and enterprise HR. I lead with research, sketch before pixels, and tie every decision back to a business outcome.

I'm currently at Workday designing talent management and benefits experiences, with a focus on integrating AI into core HR workflows. Before Workday: Twine, Sam's Club / Walmart Labs, Verifone, Clip, VISA Checkout, PlaySpan, FanSnap.

Process

A repeatable six-step practice.

The same loop \u2014 research, synthesis, ideate, prototype, validate, metrics \u2014 has held up across every team and product I\u2019ve worked on. Tap a step to dig in.

Read the process→
  1. 01
    Research

    Stakeholder interviews, on-site observation, journey mapping. Get out of the office and into the merchant’s shop, the member’s club, the user’s couch.

  2. 02
    Synthesis

    Cluster findings, articulate insights, frame the problem. Translate research into something a cross-functional team can act on.

  3. 03
    Ideate

    Sketch first, never start in the computer. Diverge wide, share the wall, get feedback early before committing pixels.

  4. 04
    Prototype

    Lo-fi to hi-fi as the story sharpens. Printable, clickable, coded — whatever the question demands.

  5. 05
    Validate

    Test with real users in their context. Iterate on what we learn. Repeat until the experience clears.

  6. 06
    Metrics

    Tie the work back to business outcomes. Engagement, conversion, GMV, NPS. Design that doesn’t move the needle isn’t finished.
